nodes.title: units
nodes.description: Set the unit system for the simulation. Must appear before the simulation box is defined. Common choices: metal (eV, Å, ps, K, bar) for materials, real (kcal/mol, Å, fs, K, atm) for biomolecular, lj (reduced) for generic models.

keywords.real: kcal/mol, Å, fs, K, atm — biomolecular
keywords.metal: eV, Å, ps, K, bar — materials science

nodes.restrictions: Cannot be used after simulation box is defined (read_data, create_box).

nodes.title: boundary
nodes.description: Set boundary style for each dimension. p = periodic (required for NPT barostatted dimensions), f = fixed (non-periodic), s = shrink-wrap, m = minimum. For bulk NVE/NVT/NPT: use p p p.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: timestep
nodes.description: Set MD timestep size. Default varies by units: lj=0.005τ, real=1.0fs, metal=0.001ps, si=1e-8s. Tdamp recommendation for NVT: ~100*dt. Pdamp recommendation for NPT: ~1000*dt liquid, ~10000*dt solid.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: atom_style
nodes.description: Define what attributes are stored per atom. atomic (id,type,x,v), charge (+q), full (molecular: bonds,angles,dihedrals,impropers + charge), molecular (no charge). Must be set before read_data or create_box.
nodes.restrictions: Must be set before read_data or create_box.

nodes.title: lattice
nodes.description: Define crystal lattice for use by create_atoms. style: none, sc, bcc, fcc, hcp, diamond, custom. scale: lattice constant in distance units. Used with region + create_atoms to build crystals.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: region
nodes.description: Define geometric region. style: block, sphere, cylinder, cone, prism, union, intersect, subtract. Blocks defined by xlo xhi ylo yhi zlo zhi. Used as input to create_box, create_atoms, group, fix, compute, dump.

block.desc: xlo xhi ylo yhi zlo zhi.

nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: create_box
nodes.description: Create a simulation box with N atom types, using the specified region for dimensions. Defines the simulation domain. Requires units and boundary to be set first. Must be called before create_atoms.
nodes.restrictions: Requires units and boundary set first. Region must exist.

nodes.title: create_atoms
nodes.description: Create atoms of given type in the simulation box. style: box (fill entire box on lattice), region (fill region on lattice), random (random positions), single (one atom at specified position). Requires lattice, region, and create_box to be set first.
nodes.restrictions: Requires lattice, region, create_box. Must have periodic boundaries.

nodes.title: read_data
nodes.description: Read a LAMMPS data file containing simulation box dimensions, atom coordinates, and optionally topology (bonds, angles, etc.). Defines the simulation box. Alternative to create_box + create_atoms for complex systems.

add.desc: add merge|append offset N — for adding atoms to existing system.

offset.desc: Atom type offset for merge operations.

nodes.restrictions: Defines the simulation box. Must be after units, boundary, atom_style.

nodes.title: velocity
nodes.syntax: velocity group-ID style args keyword value ...
nodes.description: Set or change atom velocities. create: random velocities at temperature T with seed. set: explicit vx vy vz. scale: rescale to target T. zero: cancel linear/angular momentum. Tip: for rigid bodies, do 'run 0' then 'velocity all scale T'.
examples: velocity all create 300.0 4928459 rot yes dist gaussian
nodes.restrictions: create with rigid bodies/SHAKE: do run 0 then velocity scale T.

nodes.title: pair_style lj/cut
nodes.description: Define pair potential. lj/cut: Lennard-Jones 12-6 with cutoff, E=4ε[(σ/r)¹²−(σ/r)⁶] for r<rcut. Basic model for noble gases and generic MD. For NVT/NPT with real materials, use eam, meam, reaxff, or buck.
nodes.restrictions: Must be set before pair_coeff, fix, run.

nodes.title: pair_coeff
nodes.description: Set coefficients for pair interactions between atom types I and J. For lj/cut: epsilon sigma [cutoff]. Use * * to set all pairs. Must be called after pair_style.
nodes.restrictions: Must be after pair_style and mass.

nodes.title: fix nve
nodes.description: Plain NVE ensemble via velocity-Verlet integration. No thermostat or barostat — only updates positions and velocities from forces. Combine with fix langevin for Brownian dynamics thermostat. Use fix nvt/npt if you need temperature/pressure control.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: fix langevin
nodes.syntax: fix ID group-ID langevin Tstart Tstop damp seed keyword values ...
nodes.description: Stochastic Langevin thermostat. F = F_c + F_f + F_r (conservative + friction + random). F_f = -(m/damp)*v. Random force uniform (not Gaussian). Does NOT perform time integration — MUST be combined with fix nve. Temperature ramps Tstart→Tstop over run.
nodes.restrictions: Must be combined with fix nve (does NOT perform time integration).

nodes.title: fix nvt / fix npt / fix nph
nodes.syntax:
fix ID group-ID style_name keyword value ...
  style_name = nvt | npt | nph
nodes.description:
Nose-Hoover thermostat+barostat. nvt: canonical (T). npt: isothermal-isobaric (T+P). nph: isenthalpic (P only). Performs BOTH thermostatting AND time integration — do NOT combine with fix nve on the same atoms. Internally creates compute fix_ID_temp and fix_ID_press.

Key keywords: temp Tstart Tstop Tdamp, iso/aniso/tri Pstart Pstop Pdamp. Tdamp~100*dt. Pdamp~1000*dt liquid / ~10000*dt solid. tchain=3, pchain=3, mtk=yes by default.

nreset.desc: Reset ref cell every N steps.

nodes.restrictions: Barostatted dimensions must be periodic. Tstop != 0.0. Do NOT combine with fix nve.

nodes.title: compute temp
nodes.description: Compute temperature: T=2*Ekin/(N_DOF*kB). N_DOF=dim*N-dim-fix_constraints. Auto-compute thermo_temp created at startup. Used internally by fix nvt/npt for thermostat control.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: compute pressure
nodes.syntax: compute ID group-ID pressure temp-ID keyword ...
nodes.description: Compute pressure: P=(N*kB*T+Virial)/V. Includes pair/bond/angle/dihedral/improper/kspace/fix contributions. Needs a temperature compute (usually thermo_temp). Auto-compute thermo_press created at startup. Used internally by fix npt/nph for barostat control.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: thermo
nodes.description: Print thermodynamic info every N timesteps. 0 = start/end only. N can be an equal-style variable for dynamic scheduling (logfreq, stride, stagger). For NVT/NPT, thermo 100 prints T, P, E every 100 steps.
nodes.restrictions: None.

nodes.title: thermo_style
nodes.description: Control what thermodynamic data is printed. one: step temp epair emol etotal press. multi: labeled multi-line. custom: any combination of 40+ fields (step,temp,press,pe,ke,etotal,vol,density,pxx-pyz,c_ID,f_ID,v_name). Must come after box is defined.
examples: thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol
nodes.restrictions: Must come after read_data, read_restart, or create_box.

nodes.title: dump
nodes.syntax: dump ID group-ID style N file args
nodes.description: Write atom snapshots every N timesteps. style: atom (LAMMPS format), custom (choose fields), xyz (generic XYZ), image (rendered image). For NVT/NPT trajectory: dump 1 all custom 100 traj.lammpstrj id type x y z.
examples: dump 1 all custom 100 traj.lammpstrj id type x y z
nodes.restrictions: Must be after box defined.

nodes.title: Thermostat Guide
nodes.description: Guide to temperature control in LAMMPS. Nose-Hoover (fix nvt): deterministic, correct NVT/NPT ensemble. Langevin (fix langevin): stochastic, simple. Berendsen (fix temp/berendsen): weak coupling, NOT correct ensemble, deprecated. Velocity rescaling (fix temp/rescale): crude, for equilibration only.

nodes.title: Barostat Guide
nodes.description: Guide to pressure control. NPT via fix npt (Nose-Hoover): iso (isotropic), aniso (x,y,z independent), tri (full triclinic). NPH via fix nph (no thermostat). Berendsen (fix press/berendsen): deprecated. Must use periodic boundaries in barostatted dimensions. Pdamp~1000*dt liquid, ~10000*dt solid.
nodes.restrictions: Barostatted dimensions must be periodic.
